conceptProposals.label: Bathroom
conceptProposals.definition: Room/use-restroom meaning; not a bathroom fixture or BATH+ROOM composition.

conceptProposals.label: Sleep
conceptProposals.definition: Sleep as a state; not SLEEP-IN or an approved sleepy/exhausted mapping.

conceptProposals.label: Tired
conceptProposals.definition: A feeling of fatigue; degree and body expression require review.

conceptProposals.label: Doctor
conceptProposals.definition: A medical practitioner; not an academic degree/title.

conceptProposals.label: Hospital
conceptProposals.definition: A hospital facility; not patient, doctor or an automatic clinic alias.

conceptProposals.label: Hurt
conceptProposals.definition: Physical hurt/pain candidate; location, severity and emotional hurt need separate review.

conceptProposals.label: Hot
conceptProposals.definition: High temperature; not spicy food or attractiveness.

conceptProposals.label: Cold
conceptProposals.definition: Low temperature; not a head cold/illness or an automatic winter mapping.

conceptProposals.label: Coffee
conceptProposals.definition: Coffee beverage; not all drinks or an inferred order/request.

conceptProposals.label: Tea
conceptProposals.definition: Tea beverage; not a drink request or every brewing method.

conceptProposals.label: Milk
conceptProposals.definition: Milk as liquid; not the verb to milk an animal.

conceptProposals.label: Apple
conceptProposals.definition: Apple fruit; not a company or personal name.

conceptProposals.label: Bread
conceptProposals.definition: Bread as food; not a slang term for money.

conceptProposals.label: Fish
conceptProposals.definition: A fish/animal candidate; FISHING as an action is distinct.

conceptProposals.label: Vegetable
conceptProposals.definition: Vegetable as food; exact source lexical variant requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Teacher
conceptProposals.definition: A person who teaches; complete TEACHER is not simply an approved TEACH clip.

conceptProposals.label: Student
conceptProposals.definition: A learner/student; complete person component and compound realization require review.

conceptProposals.label: Read
conceptProposals.definition: Read written text; aspect, repetition and metaphorical senses are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Write
conceptProposals.definition: Produce written text; not automatically WRITE-DOWN or SIGN-A-CONTRACT.

conceptProposals.label: Book
conceptProposals.definition: A book as bound reading material; not the verb reserve.

conceptProposals.label: Hearing
conceptProposals.definition: Hearing-person/status candidate; not physical auditory action or a legal hearing.

conceptProposals.label: Again
conceptProposals.definition: Again/repeat; exact movement and sentence scope require review.

conceptProposals.label: Today
conceptProposals.definition: The current day; not an unconditional synonym for NOW.

conceptProposals.label: Tomorrow
conceptProposals.definition: The next day; repetition may change meaning and is not inferred as DAILY.

conceptProposals.label: Yesterday
conceptProposals.definition: The previous day; not general past tense for every verb.

conceptProposals.label: Morning
conceptProposals.definition: Morning time; not a reviewed GOOD-MORNING greeting.

conceptProposals.label: Night
conceptProposals.definition: Night time; not an automatic TONIGHT or GOOD-NIGHT phrase.

conceptProposals.label: Money
conceptProposals.definition: Money/currency candidate; CASH, PAY and deposits remain separate meanings.

conceptProposals.label: Buy
conceptProposals.definition: Purchase something; not shopping by repetition or metaphorical belief.

conceptProposals.label: Ask
conceptProposals.definition: Ask a question; direction and participants require review, not formal REQUEST or PRAY.

conceptProposals.label: Feel
conceptProposals.definition: Internal feeling/sensation; not touch an object or automatic FEEL-LIKE.

conceptProposals.label: Children
conceptProposals.definition: Plural young people/offspring; number, height and plural motion require review.

conceptProposals.label: Man
conceptProposals.definition: An adult male person; not a generic term for all humanity.

conceptProposals.label: Woman
conceptProposals.definition: An adult female person; preserve source variant rather than substitute MOTHER.

conceptProposals.label: Boy
conceptProposals.definition: A boy/young male person; not a generic synonym for MAN.

conceptProposals.label: Girl
conceptProposals.definition: A girl/young female person; not a generic synonym for WOMAN.

conceptProposals.label: Language
conceptProposals.definition: A human language/system of communication; not a validated programming-language mapping.

conceptProposals.label: Sign
conceptProposals.definition: Use a signed language; not a posted notice or signing a contract.

conceptProposals.label: English
conceptProposals.definition: The English language; not every British nationality/geographic sense.

conceptProposals.label: Slow
conceptProposals.definition: Low speed; movement intensity/nonmanual modification is not a grammatical speed control.

conceptProposals.label: Fast
conceptProposals.definition: High speed; not abstaining from food or every immediate/urgent meaning.

conceptProposals.label: Day
conceptProposals.definition: Day period; temporal number, past/future and duration need separate plans.

conceptProposals.label: Week
conceptProposals.definition: A week period; not a reviewed numeric-duration construction.

conceptProposals.label: Month
conceptProposals.definition: A month period; calendar name and numerical duration are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Year
conceptProposals.definition: A year period; age, number and calendar agreement need separate review.

conceptProposals.label: Pay
conceptProposals.definition: Pay money; direction/recipient is not inferred, PAY-ATTENTION is distinct.

conceptProposals.label: Car
conceptProposals.definition: A road car/vehicle; not every automobile-operation sentence.

conceptProposals.label: Bus
conceptProposals.definition: A road bus; source lexical vs fingerspelled realization must be identified.

conceptProposals.label: Train
conceptProposals.definition: A rail vehicle; not the verb to teach or train an animal.

conceptProposals.label: Walk
conceptProposals.definition: Travel on foot; manner, classifier use and direction need separate review.

conceptProposals.label: Sit
conceptProposals.definition: Be seated/sit; not every CHAIR meaning or an imperative phrase.

conceptProposals.label: Wait
conceptProposals.definition: Wait; waiting a long time, anxiety and intensity are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Finish
conceptProposals.definition: An action already done/completed; not continue until completion or every English finish sense.

conceptProposals.label: Big
conceptProposals.definition: Large size; intensity, spatial shape and degree need separate review.

conceptProposals.label: Small
conceptProposals.definition: Small size; not an unconditional LITTLE quantity or LOW amount mapping.

conceptProposals.label: Important
conceptProposals.definition: Importance; not price/value, emergencies or a generic urgency marker.

conceptProposals.label: Answer
conceptProposals.definition: Respond/answer; direction, participants and a complete reply need review.

conceptProposals.label: Tell
conceptProposals.definition: Tell information; direction/participants are not inferred from an isolated clip.

conceptProposals.label: Think
conceptProposals.definition: Think/mental consideration; not all English belief, opinion or remember meanings.

conceptProposals.label: See
conceptProposals.definition: See visually; not every visit, comprehend or metaphorical English sense.

conceptProposals.label: Listen
conceptProposals.definition: Attend/listen to sound; not necessarily physical hearing ability or a legal hearing.

conceptProposals.label: Hungry
conceptProposals.definition: Hungry for food; degree and facial expression require review.

conceptProposals.label: Thirsty
conceptProposals.definition: Need/desire for liquid from thirst; not slang or a complete drink request.

conceptProposals.label: Toilet (fixture)
conceptProposals.definition: A plumbing toilet fixture, distinct from the room or use-restroom meaning.

conceptProposals.label: Doctor (academic title)
conceptProposals.definition: A doctoral degree/title holder; distinct from the medical practitioner sense.

conceptProposals.label: Cold (cold illness)
conceptProposals.definition: A common cold illness; not low temperature.

conceptProposals.label: Hot (spicy flavor)
conceptProposals.definition: Spicy/pungent food; not high physical temperature.

conceptProposals.label: Book (reserve booking)
conceptProposals.definition: Reserve a place or service; not a bound reading object.

conceptProposals.label: Train (training action)
conceptProposals.definition: Teach or train someone; not a rail vehicle.

conceptProposals.label: Hearing (auditory sense)
conceptProposals.definition: Physical auditory perception/ability; distinct from hearing-person status.

conceptProposals.label: Hearing (legal session)
conceptProposals.definition: A legal or official hearing; not auditory perception or a hearing person.

conceptProposals.label: Sign (posted notice)
conceptProposals.definition: A posted notice/symbol; not signed-language use.

conceptProposals.label: Sign (signature action)
conceptProposals.definition: Put a signature on a document; not signed-language use.

conceptProposals.label: Fast (food abstinence)
conceptProposals.definition: Abstain from food; not high speed.
